## Context / Problem
The tests/unit/store cohort contains audited comments or docstrings that obscure current behavior with repetition, obvious narration, duplicated explanation, or historical detail. The audit is pinned to `9e65567b79ffe872534c3c656ade7b34340d8192`.

## Approach
Edit explanatory text only in this directory/subsystem cohort. Condense it to current, non-obvious rationale and constraints; retain every file-specific preserve item and consumer contract below. Grouping adjacent files from one subsystem keeps the change reviewable in one session and permits one coherent verification pass without changing executable behavior.

## Scope
- `tests/unit/store/test_git_outcome.py:1-17, 106-109, 324-329, 395-399` — Preserve operation-sensitive classification, recovery actions, subtractive policy rule, and uniqueness guards. Consumer: none found.
- `tests/unit/store/test_merge_recovery.py:1-18` — Preserve refusal fences, parsing, convergence, and uniqueness guard. Consumer: none found.
- `tests/unit/store/test_stamped_lock.py:1-18, 73-75, 116-118, 122-125, 322-336, 350-353, 430-443` — Preserve release independence, acquisition contract, uniqueness predicate, and end-to-end exclusion. Consumer: none found.
- `tests/unit/store/test_store_paths.py:1-13, 34-36, 53-55, 106-108, 187-189, 214-216, 251-253, 255-262` — Preserve canonical symlink behavior, degradation, uniqueness, and production-call-site coverage. Consumer: none found.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every listed location contains only current, non-obvious rationale or constraints after remediation; verified by reviewing the final diff against every Scope row.
- [ ] Every preserve item and consumer contract in Scope remains explicit and accurate; verified by a row-by-row completion comment and the commands under Verification.
- [ ] No executable behavior or test assertion changes; verified by the commands under Verification exiting 0.

## Verification
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make lint`
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" .venv/bin/python scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py`
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/unit/store/test_git_outcome.py tests/unit/store/test_merge_recovery.py tests/unit/store/test_stamped_lock.py tests/unit/store/test_store_paths.py`

The row-by-row diff review is authoritative for prose quality; the hygiene guard detects only its narrow deterministic history-token rule.
